subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Land with unoccupied possession __is pretending to be__ more valuable.
solution:
The correct answer is "**is likely to be.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so the correct answer must also be in the present tense.
 
 
• Thus, option 1 will be eliminated.
 
 
 
• Also, the subject of the sentence is singular.
 
 
• Thus, we can eliminate options 2 and 3.
 
 
 
• "Is likely to be" is the most appropriate option because it expresses the idea that unoccupied land is probably more valuable, without making a definitive statement.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• Land with unoccupied possession is likely to be more valuable.
 
 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "was similarly to be," is in the past tense and does not accurately convey the meaning of the original sentence.
 
• Option 2, "are likely to be," is in the plural form and does not agree with the singular subject "land."
 
• Option 3, "have likely to be," is grammatically incorrect because "have" cannot be used with "likely to be."
